**Morning Brief recap · Tue Nov 10**
The founders agreed to keep the course focused on operator decision-making, with detailed prompt and creative-strategy material added over time from student feedback, and to build competitive research into the company SaaS as its retention engine. For Black Friday they will keep one-time purchase optional and test a lower $29 entry price, judged on conversion and revenue per visitor. Brand pages are nearly ready once the cacao product reference is fixed, and video-editor hiring is the main bottleneck, with Avia possibly needing about 10 more editors.

**Discussed**
- Course scope: marketing basics, infrastructure, AI tools, tracking and one-on-one decision support
- Competitive-discovery tool as the base of the SaaS: repeat runs, ad-library data, creative dashboards, possible AI briefs
- Adding 4Play and Get Hooked as data sources and reducing reliance on outside tools
- Brand pages connected to the checkout channel; Clinician's Choice page shows Maya ceremonial cacao by mistake
- Subscription data: about 80% subscribe and 20% one-time purchase
- Pricing comparison: Hascap at 39/59/79 against Clarity MD at 29/59/89
- Walmart and Target marketplace setup in progress
- Senior video-editor role to train and quality-check other editors; developer to speed up SaaS, course and onboarding work

**Decided**
- Keep the course operator-first; detailed creative strategy is bonus material that grows with members
- Make the company SaaS the home for competitive research and recurring reports
- Keep one-time purchase available alongside subscription
- Test a $29 entry price for Black Friday, measured on conversion and revenue per visitor
- Start ads once the cacao reference on the brand page is corrected
- Youssef takes the senior video-editor candidate call today

**Tasks (10)**
- Finalise the course details, including the Ad Creators Lab section — Brandon · due Nov 17
- Record the additional course videos over the weekend — Brandon · due Nov 15
- Set up Walmart and Target marketplace presence — Brandon · due Nov 17
- Correct the Maya ceremonial cacao reference on the Clinician's Choice page — Youssef · due Nov 17
- Bring Cassandra in to source and train video editors — Brandon · due Nov 17
- Send the developer call link to Youssef — Brandon · due Nov 10
- Build the competitive-discovery tool for repeatable research reports — Youssef · due Nov 17
- Add 4Play and Get Hooked as data sources to the competitive-research tool — Youssef · due Nov 17
- Run the senior video editor candidate call — Youssef · due Nov 10
- Test a $29 entry price for Black Friday and track conversion and revenue per visitor — Brandon · due Nov 17
